paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Comparison of different query selection strategies. During training, we first expand the document with a query selected from the generated queries using a specific strategy, and then train DPR with the expanded document. During inference, we evaluate the well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion (solid lines) and the typical representation (dotted lines) on the dev set of MS-Marco, where the solid and dotted lines with the same color are results for the same DPR.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the "Number of queries used during inference (S).", using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows "MRR@10", also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is "DPR w/o query" with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is "DPR w/ curriculum", red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and slightly increasing to a value of around 35.8 by the x-axis end. The third line is "DPR w/ top-1" green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 33.0 and increasing sharply, 34.6 x = 2, and then further increases to 36.5 at x =10. The fourth line is "DPR w/ random" blue, with circle markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and increases slightly and then stabilizes along x-axis and end at 35.3 at x = 10. The fifth line is "DPR w/ bottom-1" purple, with circle markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and increases slightly and then decreases and stabilizes along x-axis and end at 34.6 at x = 10. The sixth line is "DPR w/ gold" yellow, with circle markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 33 at x = 4 and increases sharply along x-axis and end at 35.0 at x = 10. There are 4 dashed line, red, blue, purple and green, at 35.6, 35.1, 34.9 and 34.6. Some of the lines intersect each other. A legend is given bottom right.
